dialogues.text: Ugh... Can we go back, Javita?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's up?

dialogues.speaker: Chintutu
dialogues.text: I... I don't know what to do anymore. I'm Kintutu, and I'm a...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Natlanese tourist...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, that was kinda obvious.

dialogues.speaker: Chintutu
dialogues.text: Yes, and this guy running around is my friend, Javita...

dialogues.speaker: Chintutu
dialogues.text: *sigh* Maybe we shouldn't have come to Snezhnaya. Javita got kinda gloomy the moment we arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Chintutu
dialogues.text: Logic says that Flowfire Birds shouldn't be afraid of the cold... But maybe it's not about fear. Maybe the sudden change in environment's just made her uncomfortable...

dialogues.speaker: Chintutu
dialogues.text: So, at the locals' recommendation, I came to this hot spring... and wouldn't you know it? Javita perked up right away.

dialogues.speaker: Chintutu
dialogues.text: Maybe even a bit too much — she's broken all the railings, running this way and that. There's been no stopping her, either. If I went one way, she'd go another, and so on...

dialogues.speaker: Chintutu
dialogues.text: I need some way to block her path a bit... Or chase her out of the water, hmph!

dialogues.speaker: Outdoor Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: (A notice planted in the wilds. It reads as follows...)

dialogues.speaker: Outdoor Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "This hot spring was created by the runoff of (...) pipes, and is thus the common property of all. Please maintain it carefully... and do not under any circumstances report it to the Energy Commission."

dialogues.speaker: Outdoor Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "Humans, please take off your dirty clothes and wash yourselves before entering... Volkodlak should remove any loose fur first... And if you Vila are going to gripe about this and that and everything, just don't come here, alright?"

dialogues.speaker: Outdoor Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "For Jack Frosts and Snegovik, please pay attention to the length of time you spend in here... to avoid fainting due to overexposure..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, looks like a list of "things you should take note of at a hot spring."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, can Jack Frosts and Snegovik really take hot spring baths? Do you think they'll pop out afterward and say, "This hot spring is pretty good for losing weight" or something?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Finally, the Flowfire Bird that had gone berserk in the hot springs calmed down, growing almost sad, as if realizing that this place was not home.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow. Paimon never thought we'd see a look of dejection on this Flowfire Bird's face.

dialogues.speaker: Chintutu
dialogues.text: Javita! Oh, you... Finally calmed down, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Gravita
dialogues.text: Squark?

dialogues.speaker: Chintutu
dialogues.text: *sigh* Never mind.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, well, as long as she's calmed down, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Chintutu
dialogues.text: Thank you both so, so much! I think we should head back soon, for her health's sake if nothing else...

dialogues.speaker: Chintutu
dialogues.text: I really don't know how to thank you two... Oh yeah. You say "thank you" too, Javita!

dialogues.speaker: Gravita
dialogues.text: Squark?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, so long as she understands you!

dialogues.speaker: Outdoor Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "Flowcurrent Birds... Flowfire Birds... are all prohibited from entering the hot spring! Not! Allowed!"
